message.reasoning_content: We need to answer: "Who was the First Prophert to the sixth Pharaoh of the Eighteenth Dynasty?" Likely typo: "First Prophert" maybe "First Prophet"? Or "First Prophert" maybe "First Prophet"? The sixth Pharaoh of the Eighteenth Dynasty is Thutmose III (as per evidence: "Thutmose III ... was the sixth Pharaoh of the Eighteenth Dynasty.") So question: Who was the First Prophet to Thutmose III? Need evidence. Look at evidence list: we have info about Hatshepsut, Seqenenre Tao, Meritaten, Nakhtmin, Parennefer. None mention "First Prophet". Maybe "First Prophet" refers to "First Prophet of Amun"? Parennefer was High Priest of Amun during reigns of Tutankhamen and Horemheb, not Thutmose III. Nakhtmin was generalissimo. No. Could be "First Prophet" is a title for a priest. Not in evidence. So answer unknown => "noanswer". Provide empty citations.
